frontend.note: The threshold equals the level reached and never drops. When coverage grows, the threshold is raised by the same change. Proven to bite: raising the statements threshold above the measured level fails the run with 'does not meet global threshold'.

unitOnly.note: Coverage of the tests that need no database. Kept as a separate figure because it is not the level the backend is actually tested to.

backend.note: Measured in the golang:1.25-alpine container (no Go on the machine, see GO_RUN in the Makefile). The earlier 0.7% baseline measured `go test` without -tags=integration, so it could not see the suites that carry the backend - authorization and IDOR, the section 16 transitions and AC-NOTIF-01..19 - all of which are behind the integration build tag and need a database. The 55.5% figure is the same suites measured with the tag and with -coverpkg spread across every internal package. The threshold equals the level reached and never drops.
